units: Y. Succ. IV, 54ᵇ bot. לא תעבדון ת׳ בשבתא (= יומא דת׳) do not arrange the calendar so as to make the New Year’s Day fall on a Sabbath; a. e.—Esp. the prayers on the New Year interspersed with blowing the Shofar, the Musaf of the New Year’s Day.
